Finite native qualification is 128 exact source-derived allocation/guard cases across two selector lanes and all16 record positions, with full192-byte pool and32 surrounding canary bytes; no gameplay qualification.
Four profile inputs are raw32-bit source words; low16 bits are copied into the pool. Coordinate units and descriptor interpretation remain unproven.
Pool format:16records stride12; active byte, selector byte, four little-endian halfwords, two cleared bytes. Full pool reuses first record; duplicate active selector suppresses allocation.
Explicit experimental mixed-width proof applies to this reviewed component only. Global default remains fail-closed.
ARM original ABI clobbers r0-r3/r7/r9/r11/r12; source-pinned saved-LR return proof and bounded reference-window oracle were used.
